verdict.rationale: sevDesk is a SaaS accounting product with a REST API, so agent-oriented documentation is a fair axis. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec (all returned HTTP 404). The general REST API documentation is an adjacent developer resource, not agent-oriented docs, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
